# ITGLA

> ITGLA is a local-first desktop server inventory for organizing IP addresses, ports, tags, projects, and custom operational fields.

## Product

- ITGLA helps independent developers and small teams keep operational server details in one searchable table.
- It supports tags, IP addresses, ports, spreadsheet imports, column mapping, custom fields, sorting, filtering, and copying individual cells.
- Version 0.4.0 adds manual service/domain inventory with versions, ports, tags, notes, hosting/origin servers, registrar/expiry/CDN fields, and directed service relations. Optional service account protection is Windows-only (CurrentUser DPAPI); Linux/macOS support metadata. Full database backups include this inventory; legacy project JSON does not.
- The desktop application stores its workspace in a local SQLite database.
- The desktop application does not require an account, provide cloud sync, upload workspaces, execute server commands, deploy services, or replace monitoring and secrets-management tools. Website sign-in and hosted workspaces are separate from the local desktop application.

## Privacy boundary

Server inventory data belongs to the user and remains in the local desktop workspace. Website analytics are separate from desktop product data; see the privacy policy for website log and retention details.
